scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --project bench ruff check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test --path-ignore-patterns "packages/ui/**" --path-ignore-patterns "e2e/**" packages bench/ts test && bun test -r ./packages/ui/test/dom-setup.ts packages/ui && uv run --project bench pytest
